items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Ivan Rolay, and he'll tell you, because he used to take care of me; he was like my big brother in the band

ctx.x: It was prevalent at that time. And you know, I heard the guys saying that, and I wanted to be a man, so here I am, at the age of 15, I got my first dose, and I walked up to this fellow who is here right now -- Ivan Rolay, and he'll tell you, because he used to take care of me; he was like my big brother in the band -- he used to give me hell all the time because I was always doing something dumb, you know?
He was the bass player with Jonah Jones.
